ns2:section.sectionText: This seminar introduces students in the Masters in European Union Studies degree program to the processes involved in developing and completing an MA thesis project. Topics covered may include departmental and Graduate College thesis requirements; research methodologies; library resources in EU studies; conducting effective field research; on-campus resources for thesis writing; practical advice on managing a thesis project; and electronic thesis deposit. As a course requirement, each student will develop a thesis prospectus, to be presented to colleagues at the conclusion of the course. For Graduate Credit only. Meets at International Studies Building, Rm. 200
